subject: delta(client): WF accept a plain-http node root on the approved testnet chain at the transport owner, the network binder and the wallet provider
note: The client's three node endpoint checks now call the wire's canonicalNodeEndpoint instead of their own https rule, each keeping its own refusal. createNodeTransportOwner takes an optional chainIdentity, the identity the caller pins for the connection, and refuses with transport_mismatch any endpoint the rule refuses under it; without it the owner takes an https root only. createDemosNetworkBinder judges the pin's endpoint (unpinned_network) and each transport context (transport_mismatch) under the pinned chain identity. The standalone wallet provider imports nothing, so createDevnetAgreementWalletTransport and createSdkWalletSession take the rule as an optional nodeEndpoint and apply it to the Agreement transport binding's endpoint under that binding's chain identity; without it the provider keeps its https-only check. The Node session passes canonicalNodeEndpoint to both. A plain-http root is therefore accepted only on the approved TP-1 chain, and the existing live chain read at binding still refuses a node that reports another chain before any key is loaded or anything is signed. New test file node-endpoint.test.mjs covers each site and the composed session over http, including a node that reports another chain.
